user.title: Add ESL label
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of the label. Advertised addresses start with 66:66.

data_description.scan_interval_min: How often to connect for status and version. Battery level arrives passively from advertisements, so a long interval is fine.

error.invalid_address: Not a valid Bluetooth address, expected AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

abort.already_configured: This label is already set up

data_description.write_mode: How commands are written over Bluetooth. Try 'without response' if the LED and clear screen do nothing while sensors still update.
data_description.linger_s: How long to hold the Bluetooth connection after a command. Reconnecting means waiting for the label to advertise again, which takes minutes, so a short linger makes follow-up commands instant. 0 disconnects immediately.

device_id.name: Label
device_id.description: The ESL to send this to.

on_ms.name: On time
on_ms.description: Blink on time in milliseconds. Defaults to the RGB on time number entity.

off_ms.name: Off time
off_ms.description: Blink off time in milliseconds. Defaults to the RGB off time number entity.

work_ms.name: Duration
work_ms.description: Total run time in milliseconds. Defaults to the RGB duration number entity.

device_id.name: Label
device_id.description: The ESL to send this to.

set_image.name: Set image
set_image.description: Renders an image file and uploads it to the panel. Experimental: the pixel format is not documented by the vendor.

device_id.name: Label
device_id.description: The ESL to send this to.

path.name: File path
path.description: Path to the image. Must be inside an allowed directory.

rotate.name: Rotation
rotate.description: Rotate before fitting to the panel.

invert.name: Invert
invert.description: Swap black and white on 1 bit panels.

encoding.name: Encoding
encoding.description: Pixel format to try. 'auto' follows the panel model. The vendor document does not specify this, so trying variants is expected.

bit_order.name: Bit order
bit_order.description: Whether the first pixel sits in the most or least significant bits of a byte.

debug_probe.name: Debug probe
debug_probe.description: Connects, enumerates the GATT table and reads every characteristic, then shows the result as a notification. Use this when something does not work.

device_id.name: Label
device_id.description: The ESL to send this to.

debug_command.name: Debug command
debug_command.description: Writes raw hex bytes to the command characteristic. For working out an encoding the vendor document leaves open.

device_id.name: Label
device_id.description: The ESL to send this to.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Command bytes as hex, for example 'a5 04'.

expect_response.name: Write with response
expect_response.description: Whether to use an ATT write with response.

send_test_pattern.name: Send test pattern
send_test_pattern.description: Uploads a built-in pattern so the panel can be verified without an image file. The diagnostic pattern shows which part of the encoding is wrong.

device_id.name: Label
device_id.description: The ESL to send this to.

encoding.name: Encoding
encoding.description: Pixel format to try. 'auto' follows the panel model. The vendor document does not specify this, so trying variants is expected.

bit_order.name: Bit order
bit_order.description: Whether the first pixel sits in the most or least significant bits of a byte.

rotate.name: Rotation
rotate.description: Rotate before fitting to the panel.

invert.name: Invert
invert.description: Swap black and white on 1 bit panels.

debug_command_sweep.name: Debug command sweep
debug_command_sweep.description: Sends several encodings of one command in a single connection and reports how the status characteristic reacted to each. Waking the label is the slow part, so this tests every candidate in one go.

device_id.name: Label
device_id.description: The ESL to send this to.

opcode.name: Opcode
opcode.description: Command to try, as hex. Variants are derived from it: big endian, little endian, and with trailing length bytes.

payloads.name: Payloads
payloads.description: Explicit list of hex payloads. Overrides opcode.

settle.name: Settle time
settle.description: Seconds to wait after each write before reading the status back.

preset.name: Candidate set
preset.description: clear_screen tries both documented ways to clear the panel (0xA504 and 0xA509 with index -2). opcode derives byte order variants from the opcode field instead.
